idea.title: Jack Dorsey launches Buzz to combine team chat, AI agents and Git hosting

plan.tagline: Effortlessly manage your team chat, AI agents, and Git hosting all in one place.
plan.problem: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses struggle with managing multiple tools for communication, collaboration, and version control.
plan.solution: Buzz combines team chat, AI agents, and Git hosting into a single, user-friendly CLI tool. It allows users to communicate, automate tasks, and manage code repositories in one place.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who need efficient tools for remote work and project management.
plan.demo_script: Shows basic team chat functionality, AI agent responses, and Git repository management.
